# Studio Naomikaa

> Studio Naomikaa is an India-serving interior design studio founded by Brishti Roy, providing planning-first interior design for homes, apartments, hotels, offices, cafés and retail spaces. Named after founder Brishti Roy's daughter, Naomikaa (born 4 January 2024), the studio was launched to pursue a long-held passion for architecture and interior design as a profession.

## Company
- Name: Studio Naomikaa
- Founder & Principal Designer: Brishti Roy
- Phone: +91 83060 97049
- Email: tobrishtiroy66@gmail.com
- Website: https://studionaomikaa.in/
- Service area: India
- Studio location: Kondapur, JV Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500084, India

## Services
- Residential interior design
- Home and apartment interior design
- Hotel interior design
- Office interior design
- Café and retail interior design
- Space planning
- Concept design
- Materials and lighting specification
- Turnkey interior execution and site supervision
